content.short: PawSwap lets you swap tokens at a discount and donate the savings to a charity of your choice.
content.description: PawSwap makes it simple for users to donate the tax-rate savings from their token swaps to thousands of charities and causes they care about. Projects are drawn to PawSwap by the prospect of lower tax rates, helping ease selling pressure on their price charts. PawSwap then accumulates the taxes in the blockchain’s native token, using those reserves to further reduce a project’s sell pressure and support sustainable growth. By aligning donor incentives with project growth, PawSwap promotes charitable giving within a vibrant DeFi ecosystem.
